payload.text: Faça um aplicativo mobile para dimensionamento de eletrocalhas. O aplicativo devera possuir multiplas entradas de cabeamento para o utilizador poder escolher a quantidade de cabos que vai colocar. Ele podera escolhar a bitola do cabo e a quantidade de cabos que irão passar na inra estrutura. O Aplicativo como resposta deverá dar multiplas respostas, mostrando a opção de leito, eletrocalha e eletroduto. Depois de dar a resposta o usuario ainda podera escolher se ira querer aumentar a altura do leitou ou da eletrocalha e o aplicativo devera atualizar a largura. Vou enviar umas fotos de uma planilha em excel que faz isso para voce poder ter como base. siga a norma nbr 5410

I'm currently focusing on outlining the logical steps required for the sizing calculations. My next step will be to detail how these inputs are translated into size calculations.


**Determining Sizing Parameters**

I'm now diving into the specifics of the calculation engine. My focus is on determining cross-sectional areas based on NBR 5410 occupancy rates, especially for Leito, Eletrocalha, and Eletroduto. The goal is to provide size suggestions. I'm building interactive features allowing height (aba) adjustments, with the width updating automatically to maintain valid occupancy. I'm also addressing the need to incorporate manufacturer-specific cable diameters, since they vary. I'm reviewing the spreadsheet data to categorize the cables and occupancy limits.


**Refining User Interface**

I'm now prioritizing the user interface design. I'm aiming for a dark, industrial theme with a clean, card-based mobile UI that provides real-time updates. The app structure will be divided into sections for Power, Control, and Signal cables. I'm focusing on cable input components and result card display components. I'm setting up the basic React structure with `index.html`, `index.tsx`, `App.tsx`, `types.ts`, and `constants.ts` files, and I'm setting the `metadata.json`.


**Implementing Calculation Logic**

I've just added the crucial `utils/calculations.ts` file, where the sizing logic will live. I'm focusing now on integrating the cable diameter estimations based on NBR 5410, and manufacturers' specifications, into the calculations. My plan is to factor in occupancy rates (40% for trays, varying for conduits). I'll design the interface to show real-time area calculation as the user inputs cable type, gauge, and quantity. I will now render results for Leito, Eletrocalha, and Eletroduto.
